entries.headline: Posts claim flu vaccine stock below half after nearly 3.76 million doses
entries.why: Supply perception is now the main flu story; the posts do not say whether they mean public (公費) or self-pay (自費) stock, and the latest official word was Taiwan CDC's 13 Oct plan for extra doses. A 'quadrivalent vaccine has disappeared?' explainer suggests some public confusion over formulations.
entries.headline_zh: 貼文稱流感疫苗接種近376萬劑後庫存剩不到一半
entries.why_zh: 供應觀感已成為流感議題主軸；相關貼文未說明指的是公費或自費庫存，而最新官方說法為疾管署10月13日的追加採購計畫。一篇「四價疫苗消失了？」的說明文顯示民眾對疫苗劑型有所混淆。

entries.headline: Infant RSV antibody cost and eligibility questions surface in doctor and parent posts
entries.why: A doctor's post ranks the infant RSV long-acting antibody first, citing about NT$16,000-17,000 per dose and saying NHI covers only high-risk preterm infants. Parents share bills and ask about eligibility after age one, so this is mainly a self-pay (自費) issue with narrow public coverage.
entries.headline_zh: 醫師與家長貼文浮現嬰兒RSV抗體費用及適用資格疑問
entries.why_zh: 一則醫師貼文將嬰兒RSV長效抗體列為首選，指每劑約NT$16,000-17,000，並稱健保僅給付高風險早產兒。家長分享帳單並詢問滿一歲後的適用資格，因此這主要是自費議題，公費涵蓋範圍狹窄。

entries.headline: Matsu reports nearly 100 flu cases in two weeks; Tainan passes 310,000 doses
entries.why: Outbreak and uptake coverage keeps pressure on the public (公費) programme: Tainan opened extra holiday stations, and the Matsu report also mentions self-pay vaccination. Kaohsiung cancelled all city vaccination stations on 23 Oct; the notice gives no reason.
entries.headline_zh: 馬祖兩週內近100例流感；台南接種突破31萬劑
entries.why_zh: 疫情與接種報導持續對公費計畫形成壓力：台南加開假日接種站，馬祖報導亦提及自費接種。高雄於10月23日取消全市接種站，公告未說明原因。

entries.headline: Doctors frame flu and COVID-19 as heart risks, mentioning adjuvanted and high-dose options
entries.why: Enhanced flu vaccines reach mainstream health coverage through cardiovascular framing even as enhanced-flu volume fell (35 to 14 items week on week). Funding is not stated, so the relevance spans both arenas; a user post says a health ministry ad on cardiovascular risk prompted them to reconsider vaccination.
entries.headline_zh: 醫師將流感與COVID-19定位為心臟風險，並提及佐劑型與高劑量選項
entries.why_zh: 加強型流感疫苗透過心血管議題進入主流健康報導，但加強型流感聲量下滑（週比由35則降至14則）。報導未說明經費來源，因此相關性橫跨公費與自費兩端；一名用戶貼文表示，衛福部關於心血管風險的廣告讓其重新考慮接種。

entries.headline: COVID-19 mRNA safety claims recur on Threads; fact-check rebuts '74% fatality' claim
entries.why: Posts repeat claims about lipid nanoparticle spread, clots and brain harm, but engagement stays in single digits. The highest-engagement posts in this period push back on vaccine-cancer claims rather than amplify them.
entries.headline_zh: Threads上COVID-19 mRNA安全性說法反覆出現；事實查核駁斥「74%致死率」說法
entries.why_zh: 貼文重複脂質奈米粒子擴散、血栓及腦部傷害等說法，但互動數維持個位數。本期互動最高的貼文是在反駁疫苗致癌說法，而非放大它。

entries.headline: Medigen issues statement amid reports that domestic vaccine development has stalled
entries.why: Medigen also supplies Fluvacgen to the public flu programme, so any industry-policy fallout is worth tracking. The coverage gives few details, and a separate piece contrasts US cuts to mRNA funding with Japan's investment in domestic mRNA vaccines.
entries.headline_zh: 國產疫苗研發傳停滯，高端發表聲明
entries.why_zh: 高端亦供應公費流感計畫的Fluvacgen，任何產業政策衝擊都值得追蹤。相關報導細節不多，另有一篇文章對比美國削減mRNA經費與日本投資國產mRNA疫苗。

watch.text: Second stage of publicly funded flu vaccination opens; watch for Taiwan CDC supply statements given posts claiming stock is below half.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打；鑑於貼文稱庫存不到一半，留意疾管署供應說明。

watch.text: Expanded eligibility for publicly funded flu antivirals expires; watch whether Taiwan CDC extends it again as the season stays active.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感抗病毒藥物擴大適用對象到期；流感季持續活躍，留意疾管署是否再度延長。

watch.text: Arrival and allocation of the additional flu and Novavax doses Taiwan CDC said on 13 Oct it plans to procure.
watch.text_zh: 疾管署10月13日表示計畫採購的追加流感疫苗與Novavax疫苗之到貨及配送。

qa.q: Is public flu vaccine supply actually running short?
qa.a: Posts claim stock is below half after nearly 3.76 million doses, but there has been no new official supply statement in the last 72 hours. Taiwan CDC said on 13 Oct that uptake was strong and it plans additional flu doses.
qa.q_zh: 公費流感疫苗是否真的供應不足？
qa.a_zh: 貼文稱接種近376萬劑後庫存剩不到一半，但過去72小時無新的官方供應說明。疾管署10月13日表示接種踴躍，並計畫追加流感疫苗。

qa.q: Are enhanced (adjuvanted / high-dose) flu vaccines still part of the conversation?
qa.a: Only at the margins. Enhanced-flu volume fell from 35 to 14 items week on week, and current mentions come through doctor commentary linking flu to cardiovascular risk in older adults, without funding details.
qa.q_zh: 加強型（佐劑型／高劑量）流感疫苗是否仍在討論中？
qa.a_zh: 僅屬邊緣話題。加強型流感聲量週比由35則降至14則，目前提及多來自醫師將流感與長者心血管風險連結的評論，且未提經費細節。

qa.q: Is the US military Moderna flu-vaccine ban rumour still a live issue?
qa.a: Taiwan CDC called it false on 20 Oct, explaining that the vaccine is not yet recommended by the US CDC. Rumour storylines were active over the past week, but no new rumour items appear among the top posts of the last 72 hours.
qa.q_zh: 美軍禁用Moderna流感疫苗謠言是否仍在發酵？
qa.a_zh: 疾管署於10月20日澄清為不實，說明該疫苗尚未獲美國CDC建議使用。謠言話題在過去一週活躍，但過去72小時的熱門貼文中未見新的謠言內容。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the phase-one eligibility for 11 groups and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, and it referenced self-pay options, defining the boundary between the public and self-pay arenas.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定第一階段11類接種對象及1,350健康幣獎勵，並提及自費選項，劃定公費與自費的界線。

policy_notes.why: Formal launch of the joint 左流右新 campaign confirms enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents 65+ and that both Moderna and Novavax are part of COVID-19 supply.
policy_notes.why_zh: 「左流右新」聯合接種活動正式啟動，確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax均為COVID-19疫苗供應來源。

policy_notes.why: This notice set the 2026-27 narrative that public flu and COVID-19 uptake is outpacing last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此公告定調2026-27年度敘事：公費流感與COVID-19疫苗接種進度超越去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種。

policy_notes.why: Adds Novavax to the public COVID-19 programme from 19 Oct and signals extra flu and Novavax procurement, the key supply decision of the season so far.
policy_notes.why_zh: 自10月19日起將Novavax納入公費COVID-19接種計畫，並表示將追加採購流感疫苗與Novavax，為本季迄今最關鍵的供應決策。

policy_notes.why: Pre-holiday call reiterating rising uptake, the health-coin incentive and Novavax as an option for eligible groups.
policy_notes.why_zh: 連假前呼籲，重申接種率上升、健康幣誘因，以及Novavax可供符合資格族群選擇。

policy_notes.why: Public notice of the antiviral eligibility extension to 15 Nov, noting antivirals are not NHI-covered, which frames the season as ongoing.
policy_notes.why_zh: 公告抗病毒藥物適用對象延長至11月15日，並說明抗病毒藥物非健保給付，顯示流感季仍持續中。

policy_notes.why: Physician-facing letter extending public antiviral eligibility to 15 Nov, a sign Taiwan CDC still sees an active flu season.
policy_notes.why_zh: 致醫師函，將公費抗病毒藥物適用對象延長至11月15日，顯示疾管署仍認為流感季正活躍。

policy_notes.why: Official rebuttal of the US military Moderna mRNA flu-vaccine ban rumour; it is the reference point for any stakeholder asking about the claim.
policy_notes.why_zh: 官方駁斥美軍禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗謠言；為利害關係人詢問此說法時的參考依據。

misinfo.claim: The Pentagon has banned procurement and use of Moderna's mRNA flu vaccine across the US military
misinfo.note: Taiwan CDC has already clarified this is false; keep the CDC clarification ready for stakeholder queries and watch for re-circulation.
misinfo.claim_zh: 五角大廈已禁止全美軍採購及使用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗
misinfo.note_zh: 疾管署已澄清為不實；備妥疾管署澄清內容以回應利害關係人詢問，並留意是否再度流傳。

misinfo.claim: mRNA COVID-19 vaccines spread through the body and cause clots, brain damage or cancer
misinfo.note: These claims recur across several posts but with low engagement in Taiwan; monitor, and route any media queries to official safety sources rather than issuing a brand response.
misinfo.claim_zh: mRNA COVID-19疫苗會擴散全身，導致血栓、腦損傷或癌症
misinfo.note_zh: 此類說法在多則貼文中反覆出現，但在台灣互動度低；持續監測，媒體詢問請導向官方安全性資訊來源，不以品牌名義回應。

misinfo.claim: COVID-19 vaccines have a 74% fatality rate
misinfo.note: A published fact-check has already rebutted this claim; no further action is needed beyond noting the fact-check.
misinfo.note_zh: 已有公開的事實查核駁斥此說法；除記錄該查核外無需進一步行動。

misinfo.claim: Paxlovid is a substitute for the COVID-19 vaccine and should never be used
misinfo.note: This is an isolated post with no engagement; monitor only.
misinfo.claim_zh: Paxlovid可取代COVID-19疫苗，且絕不應使用
misinfo.note_zh: 此為零互動的單一貼文；僅需監測。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: The most-engaged RSV post this week is a doctor ranking a long-acting RSV monoclonal antibody first among infant immunisations, citing about NT$16,000-17,000 per dose and NHI coverage limited to high-risk premature infants; parents separately share a preterm bill that included one RSV dose and ask whether children over one can still receive it. No brand is named.
products.implication: The conversation frames infant RSV protection as a cost and eligibility question, which feeds a reimbursement debate; one parent's post mixes up a maternal RSV shot with an infant 'booster', suggesting confusion between pathways.
products.action: Prepare an evidence and cost-of-illness briefing for reimbursement and advisory discussions, and a factual Q&A on eligibility and schedules for healthcare professionals and societies; monitor parent forums for confusion and refer to official guidance only.
products.signal_zh: 本週互動最高的RSV貼文為一名醫師將長效RSV單株抗體列為嬰兒預防接種首選，指每劑約NT$16,000-17,000，健保僅給付高風險早產兒；另有家長分享含一劑RSV的早產兒帳單，並詢問滿一歲的孩子是否仍可施打。未提及品牌。
products.implication_zh: 討論將嬰兒RSV保護定位為費用與資格問題，進而助長給付議題討論；一名家長貼文將孕婦RSV疫苗與嬰兒「追加劑」混為一談，顯示對不同途徑有所混淆。
products.action_zh: 準備實證與疾病成本簡報供給付及諮詢會議討論，並為醫療人員與學會準備適用資格及時程的事實性Q&A；監測家長論壇的混淆情形，僅引用官方指引。

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), enhanced flu for 65+ in the public programme
products.signal: High-dose mentions edged up (16 vs 12 in 7 days) while all enhanced-flu mentions fell (14 vs 35). A doctor's commentary links flu to cardiovascular risk in older adults and mentions adjuvanted and high-dose vaccines; public broadcaster coverage notes enhanced vaccines alongside self-pay options. Unverified posts claim overall flu stock is below half.
products.implication: Launch interest has faded into specialist commentary, so the first public season will be judged later on uptake and access in long-term care; general stock-depletion posts could raise questions about enhanced-dose availability.
products.action: Prepare factual supply and allocation information for CDC and local health bureaus ahead of the second stage, and brief geriatric, cardiology and long-term care stakeholders with peer-reviewed evidence on request; avoid public comparative claims.
who: Long-term care and residential facility operators
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費計畫中65歲以上適用的加強型流感疫苗
products.signal_zh: 高劑量相關提及小幅上升（7天內16則，前期12則），但加強型流感整體提及下滑（14則，前期35則）。一則醫師評論將流感與長者心血管風險連結，並提及佐劑型與高劑量疫苗；公廣媒體報導在自費選項旁提及加強型疫苗。未經證實的貼文稱流感疫苗整體庫存不到一半。
products.implication_zh: 上市話題熱度已轉為專業評論，首個公費季的成效將於日後依接種率及長照機構可近性評斷；一般性庫存耗盡貼文可能引發對加強型疫苗供應的疑問。
products.action_zh: 第二階段開打前，為疾管署與地方衛生局準備供應與配送的事實資訊，並應要求以同儕審查實證向老年醫學、心臟科及長照利害關係人說明；避免公開比較性宣稱。
who_zh: 長照及住宿型機構業者
老年醫學會與心臟學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: Pertussis booster for adolescents and adults
products.signal: Little to report: Tdap had only 3 mentions in the last 7 days (2 the week before), and none of the top items this week concern pertussis or Tdap.
products.implication: There is no current public conversation to manage; any visibility would need to come from professional channels rather than reactive response.
products.action: Keep a standing evidence pack on pertussis burden and maternal and adult boosting ready for medical-society and CDC discussions; continue monitoring for outbreak news.
products.sub_zh: 青少年與成人百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 無太多可報告內容：Tdap過去7天僅3則提及（前一週2則），本週熱門內容均與百日咳或Tdap無關。
products.implication_zh: 目前無需處理的公共討論；若要提高能見度，需透過專業管道而非被動回應。
products.action_zh: 備妥百日咳疾病負擔及孕婦與成人追加接種的常備實證資料，供醫學會與疾管署討論；持續監測疫情消息。

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: Protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi; public programme from Oct 19
products.signal: Taiwan CDC added Novavax, described as made by a different process, to the public COVID-19 programme from October 19 and said additional Novavax doses are planned; an October 20 notice repeated it as an option. No Novavax-specific social posts or media stories surfaced in the last 72 hours.
products.implication: Official endorsement is in place but public awareness depends on CDC and clinic messaging; overall COVID-19 conversation volume roughly halved week on week.
products.action: Coordinate with CDC on timing and allocation of the additional doses, and prepare factual material on the protein-based platform for clinicians and local health bureaus who field patient questions.
who: Family medicine and infectious disease societies
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質疫苗，由Sanofi在台經銷；10月19日起納入公費
products.signal_zh: 疾管署自10月19日起將以不同製程生產的Novavax納入公費COVID-19接種計畫，並表示計畫追加Novavax劑量；10月20日公告再次將其列為選項。過去72小時未出現Novavax相關社群貼文或媒體報導。
products.implication_zh: 官方已背書，但民眾認知仰賴疾管署與診所宣導；COVID-19整體討論聲量週比約減半。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署協調追加劑量的時程與配送，並為需回應病患疑問的臨床醫師及地方衛生局準備蛋白質疫苗平台的事實資料。
who_zh: 家庭醫學會與感染症醫學會

issues.title: Second-stage eligibility opens amid posts claiming flu stock below half
issues.note: Posts cite about 3.76 million doses given and supply below half, and CDC has signalled additional flu purchases; expect questions on access for newly eligible groups, including enhanced vaccines for older people.
issues.title_zh: 第二階段開放接種，同時有貼文稱流感疫苗庫存不到一半
issues.note_zh: 貼文引述已接種約376萬劑且供應不到一半，疾管署已表示將追加採購流感疫苗；預期新納入對象的接種可近性將受詢問，包括長者加強型疫苗。

issues.title: Infant RSV antibody cost and NHI coverage debate
issues.note: A doctor's post citing NT$16,000-17,000 per dose and NHI limits to high-risk preterm infants drew the week's top RSV engagement; parents share bills and eligibility questions.
issues.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV抗體費用與健保給付討論
issues.note_zh: 一則醫師貼文指每劑NT$16,000-17,000、健保僅給付高風險早產兒，獲本週最高RSV互動；家長分享帳單並提出資格疑問。

issues.title: Vaccine misinformation spilling into flu programme confidence
issues.note: CDC had to rebut a Pentagon-Moderna mRNA flu vaccine rumour, explainers address 'quadrivalent has disappeared' claims, and Threads posts falsely say COVID-19 and flu vaccines are harmful.
issues.title_zh: 疫苗錯誤資訊外溢影響流感計畫信心
issues.note_zh: 疾管署須駁斥五角大廈禁用Moderna mRNA流感疫苗謠言，說明文回應「四價消失」說法，Threads貼文則不實宣稱COVID-19與流感疫苗有害。

self_pay.title: Infant RSV antibody is a costly self-pay decision, per posts
self_pay.note: A doctor's post cites about NT$16,000-17,000 per dose with NHI covering only high-risk preterm infants, and a parent reports a bill over NT$25,000 that included one RSV dose; these are posts, not verified prices.
self_pay.title_zh: 據貼文，嬰兒RSV抗體為昂貴的自費決定
self_pay.note_zh: 一則醫師貼文指每劑約NT$16,000-17,000，健保僅給付高風險早產兒；一名家長稱帳單逾NT$25,000，其中含一劑RSV。以上為貼文內容，非經證實的價格。

self_pay.title: Self-pay flu options mentioned, but no prices or stock detail
self_pay.note: Public broadcaster, Tainan and Matsu coverage mention self-pay flu vaccination alongside the public programme, including in the context of the Nangan outbreak, without giving prices or clinic stock.
self_pay.title_zh: 提及自費流感選項，但無價格或庫存細節
self_pay.note_zh: 公廣媒體、台南及馬祖報導在公費計畫之外提及自費流感接種，包括南竿疫情脈絡，但未提供價格或診所庫存。

self_pay.title: Supply anxiety posts do not separate public and private stock
self_pay.note: Posts claiming flu supply is below half and explainers on 'missing' quadrivalent vaccine do not say whether they refer to public or clinic self-pay stock, which could confuse people outside eligible groups.
self_pay.title_zh: 供應焦慮貼文未區分公費與自費庫存
self_pay.note_zh: 稱流感疫苗供應不到一半的貼文及四價疫苗「消失」說明文，未說明指的是公費或診所自費庫存，可能使非公費對象感到混淆。

self_pay.title: Little on enhanced flu or Tdap in the self-pay market
self_pay.note: Enhanced flu vaccines are mentioned alongside self-pay options in one news report, but no items describe self-pay demand, pricing or clinic promotion for adjuvanted or high-dose flu or for Tdap this week.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費市場中加強型流感與Tdap討論甚少
self_pay.note_zh: 本週僅一則新聞在自費選項旁提及加強型流感疫苗，無任何內容描述佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗及Tdap的自費需求、價格或診所推廣。
